targets.name: Frame_WaitForVBlankWork
behavior: Clears VBLANK_READY_LATCH before waiting for the next VBlank.
Uses FRAME_WAIT_LATCH only as the conditional Z80 bus-handshake gate.
Acquires/releases the Z80 bus and services the sound-side handshake when enabled.

targets.name: VDP_CopyWordsToVRAM
behavior: Programs the VRAM destination command from A1.
Copies D0 words from A0 through VDP_DATA.
Preserves A0, A1, D0, and D1 for the caller.

targets.name: SceneResource_ProcessCommandStream
behavior: Consumes resource commands until SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS changes.
Dispatches commands below 0x20 through the shared resource table.
Routes object commands through the scene/resource actor helper.

targets.name: SceneResource_InstantiateActors
behavior: Selects a scene-resource record and initializes its rendering origin.
Resolves object entries and finds a free gameplay actor slot.
Applies Actor_InitializeFromTemplate and assigns animation, movement, and position fields.

conclusion: The queue cluster is scene/resource and VDP infrastructure. Its actor creation path is now named, while the existing transition campaign remains the authority for reachability and does not gain a new direct scene-state or player-transfer writer from these helpers.
